fact: An OBR-TRA technical meeting in Bujumbura on 22 September 2026 discussed interfacing the two countries' electronic cargo tracking systems; Burundi's system, begun in 2014, tracks goods only from its borders and Tanzanian declaration data reaches Burundi via TECTS and RECTS.
title: L'interfaçage des Systèmes de Suivi Electronique des Cargos pour la sécurité et la sûreté des Biens ou des Marchandises
